name: ascb
description: Contain information and pointers needed for Address Space Control.  The ASCB is non-swappable.

fields.name: ASCBASCB
fields.description: ACRONYM IN EBCDIC -ASCB-

fields.name: ASCBASID
fields.description: ADDRESS SPACE IDENTIFIER FOR THE ASCB

fields.name: ASCBTCBE
fields.description: Count of ready tcbs in the space that are in an enclave. Ownership:  Task Management Serialization: Compare and Swap and WEB Lock of TCB for which this count is being manipulated.

fields.name: ASCBFLG3
fields.description: Flags needing no serialization. byte is a programming interface only for bit ASCBzCX

ASCBREUS.description: This is a reusable ASID. It may be given out only to a reusable ASID requestor

ASCBM881.description: This address space went through IEEMB881

ASCBSingleStepStartedTask.description: This address space is a single step started task

ASCBzCX.description: This address space is a zCX address space

fields.name: ASCBEJST
fields.description: Accumulated job step CPU time. Non-enclave TCB time only. Unsigned 64-bit binary number

fields.name: ASCBASXB
fields.description: POINTER TO ADDRESS SPACE EXTENSION CONTROL BLOCK (ASXB)

fields.name: ASCBOUCB
fields.description: SYSTEM RESOURCES MANAGER (SRM) USER CONTROL BLOCK POINTER

fields.name: ASCBOUXB
fields.description: SYSTEM RESOURCES MANAGER (SRM) USER EXTENSION BLOCK POINTER

fields.name: ASCBJBNI
fields.description: POINTER TO JOBNAME FIELD FOR INITIATED PROGRAMS OR ZERO

fields.name: ASCBJBNS
fields.description: POINTER TO JOBNAME FIELD FOR START/MOUNT/LOGON OR ZERO

fields.name: ASCBSRBT
fields.description: ACCUMULATED SRB TIME

fields.name: ASCBTCBS
fields.description: NUMBER OF READY TCB'S. THE ACTUAL NUMBER OF READY TCBS IS ASCBTCBS-ASCBLSQT. SERIALIZATION: CS OWNERSHIP: TASK MANAGEMENT

fields.name: ASCBLSQT
fields.description: NUMBER OF TCBS ON A LOCAL LOCK SUSPEND QUEUE. SERIALIZATION: CS OWNERSHIP: TASK MANAGEMENT

fields.name: ASCBXTCB
fields.description: ADDRESS OF THE JOB STEP TASK TCB WHICH OWNS THE CROSS MEMORY RESOURCES IN THIS ADDRESS SPACE. SERIALIZATION - LOCAL LOCK. OWNERSHIP - SUPERVISOR.

fields.name: ASCBFW3
fields.description: Fullword label to address bits in this word. Serialization - CS. This word is a programming interface only for bits ASCBSDBF, ASCBNOFT, ASCBPO1M, ASCBP1M0

fields.name: ASCBASSB
fields.description: POINTER TO ADDRESS SPACE SECONDARY BLOCK (ASSB).

fields.name: ASCBLSQE
fields.description: Number of Enclave TCBs that are on a Local Lock Suspend Queue. Ownership:  Task Management Serialization:  Compare and Swap

fields.name: ASCBRSME
fields.description: POINTER TO RSM ADDRESS SPACE BLOCK EXTENSION. SERIALIZATION: RSMAD LOCK OWNERSHIP: RSM

fields.name: ASCBDCTI
fields.description: ACCUMULATED CHANNEL CONNECT TIME INCURRED BY THIS MEMORY

fields.name: ASCBEND
fields.description: END OF ASCB
